purpose: Define a human-facing encounter assessment, comparison, benchmark, recommendation and calibration procedure that deepens MV-IA-F012 without inventing a universal challenge scalar or rewriting owning-domain mechanics.

inherited_authority.feature: MV-IA-F012 Encounter Builder and Balance Lab
required_outcomes: Every analysis exposes inputs, assumptions, evidence quality, uncertainty, omitted variables and versions.
Comparison records explicit deltas between immutable snapshots.
Bounded simulation is deterministic, advisory and nonmutating.
No balanced, fair, safe, winnable, optimal or guaranteed label is permitted.

examples: change governed hazard or terrain selection
add or revise a retreat, surrender, bypass or partial-success path
change encounter-local resource availability or rest assumption where governing rules allow
change revealed encounter-local information where Campaign rules allow
resolve missing interaction rule or source contradiction before assessment
run a bounded deterministic replay or targeted sensitivity case
retain current draft because available evidence does not support a change

uncertainty_rule: Use low, moderate, high or indeterminate from the verified PPIA-11 taxonomy. Missing source mechanics, unresolved cross-scale rules, inaccessible hidden inputs or materially incomparable benchmarks increase uncertainty; indeterminate is valid and preferable to fabricated precision.

calibration_contract.rule: Calibration updates authored recommendations and benchmark evidence only. It never silently edits source truth, owning-domain mechanics or historical assessment receipts.

blocking_invariants: No universal CR, encounter level, difficulty score, threat number or cross-domain power scalar is produced.
No weighted sum is required to collapse the twelve pressure dimensions or twenty factors.
Unknown/source-unspecified values are never replaced with midpoint, zero, average or human-default values.
Boss, wave, reinforcement, retreat, hazard, objective and mixed-scale analysis organizes existing rules but does not invent mechanics.
Mixed-scale assessment requires explicit governing interaction rules; absent interaction rules can yield indeterminate.
Simulation and benchmark output is evidence, not actual-player prediction or source canon.
AI may explain or propose from the authorized projection only; it cannot approve, attach, mutate or certify balance.
Approval and Scene attachment remain MV-IA-F012/PPIA-08 human-governed operations outside the advisory analysis result.
No application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester access, paid service or production credential is activated.
